title: Why Walking Spills Your Coffee (Liquid Resonance)
caption:
It's not you, it's resonance: why coffee spills
He carries his morning coffee slow and steady, yet it still sloshes right over the rim mid-kitchen.
Your steps cycle at 1.5-2.0 Hz; when that rhythm matches the coffee's natural slosh frequency, resonance pumps each wave higher until it spills over.
Do you walk backward to save your cup, or just accept the daily spill?
Share this with the friend whose shirt wears half of their latte, and follow for more everyday physics.
